recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast black and white portrait of a man with dark hair and a mustache, where the highlights are blown out to pure white and shadows are deep black. The face is angled, creating a dramatic diagonal composition with typography layered across the upper third.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme value contrast between skin and background
Diagonal tension between the eye and the jawline
Delicate serif typography against heavy photographic shadows
coreInvariants: Deep, crushed blacks in the hair and background
Horizontal text placement in the upper left quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up portrait occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, angled downward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, detailed eye and eyebrow in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eye, follows the bridge of the nose down to the mustache, then moves up to the typography in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space on the left side and bottom edge.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure black for background and shadows
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted magenta and gold for typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value range with zero mid-tones in the skin; low saturation in accents.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses a high-contrast serif with thin hairlines
Subtitle text uses a wide-tracked, all-caps geometric sans-serif

composition.relationshipToImage: Layered over the transition between shadow and highlight

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for name paired with wide-spaced sans-serif for title.

preserve: Wide tracking on the secondary line
High contrast serif for the primary line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant serif look of the display text.
Matches the geometric, wide-tracked subtitle style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man with a mustache, looking down. Use extreme chiaroscuro lighting so the left side of the frame is pure black and the right side of his face is blown out to pure white. The image should have a grainy, film-noir texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the top left. The top line should be a large, elegant serif in muted magenta. The second line should be a small, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif in pale gold.

verificationChecks: Is the contrast extreme enough to lose detail in the highlights?
Is the tracking on the second line significantly wider than the first?

adjustableVariables: Specific hue of the magenta accent
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original person
Exact kerning of the original typography
postGenerationChecks: Check for pure black background consistency
Ensure text is legible against the high-contrast background
Verify the diagonal composition of the face
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast chiaroscuro portrait + Minimalist two-tier typography (Serif/Wide-Sans) + Muted primary/metallic color accents.
